family_reports.body: DCYF Brought 160 children over from a different county and placed them in foster care in spokane county. It added 30 extra cases on to the workers already thirty caseloads , which doubled their load and gives them no time for reunification efforts. The removals from another county is suspicious. The workers are not being transparent.They have been scrutinized multiple times in court recently for providing false information , and I witnessed the judge do nothing
